name: Xbox
notes: Deep forest carbon with three rising slashes top-right and a single wedge bottom-left. Green is darker and cooler than the mint of Hulu/Spotify; motif is slashes, not a logo.

name: Viaplay
notes: Plum-rose base with a quarter-ring sweeping out of the bottom-right corner and a shadow wedge at top-left. Ring stays clear of the centre wordmark.

name: Internet
notes: Slate base with an orbit line crossing the top-right and a small planet sitting on it, plus a quiet bottom-left wedge. Reads as a browser through orbit geometry, not a globe logo.

name: klyq
notes: Warm graphite with three stone-coloured steps rising toward the right corner, a neutral that stays distinct through its stepped geometry. Does not use gold or orange.

name: e-Manual
notes: Utility: cool neutral with a dog-eared page corner and three text-line bars along the bottom. Regular weight and low contrast so it reads as reference material, not entertainment.

name: Security Center
notes: Utility: steel-blue shield in the top-right corner and a progress-style bar bottom-left. Calm, status-like, kept out of the wordmark band.

name: Minimal TV Administration
notes: Utility: neutral graphite with two slider rails and knobs (one vertical at right, one horizontal at bottom). Reads as settings and controls; quieter than the entertainment tiles.

name: Asteroids Screensaver
notes: Near-black indigo space with irregular asteroid polygons at three corners and one streak. Retro, playful, but kept dark so it does not compete with apps.

name: Any app
notes: Neutral graphite fallback with two opposite corner wedges. Written so the wordmark can be any app name without clashing.
